$comment: Reviewed, time-boxed advisory ignores for `pnpm audit --audit-level=high`. Each entry MUST have a reason and an expiry; CI fails any entry past expiry so ignores can't rot. Empty by default — add only un-fixable transitive advisories.

ignores.reason: Pinned at 6.11.6 by @xenova/transformers → onnxruntime-web → onnx-proto@4.0.4 (declares ^6.11.2 — won't accept v7). pnpm override to v7 silently fails because onnx-proto's compiled pbjs output targets the v6 API. The advisory is RCE via protobufjs decode of attacker-controlled wire bytes; the only protobuf inputs in this codebase are bundled ONNX model files (operator-controlled). No untrusted protobuf wire traffic reaches the library. Re-review when @xenova/transformers ships a release that drops onnx-proto, or when an onnx-proto-equivalent ships against protobufjs v7.

Same chain as 1117571 (onnx-proto pinned). Code-injection through bytes-field defaults in generated toObject — requires attacker control over the protobuf schema, not the wire bytes. No untrusted schemas in this codebase (bundled ONNX models only).
Same chain as 1117571. Code-generation gadget after prototype pollution — requires a prior prototype-pollution primitive plus attacker control over the schema. Bundled ONNX models only.
Same chain as 1117571. Process-wide DoS through unsafe option paths in protobufjs codegen. Requires attacker control over option paths in the schema. Bundled ONNX models only.
Same chain as 1117571. DoS through unbounded protobuf recursion in decode. Wire-byte input only — no untrusted protobuf wire traffic reaches this library in this codebase.

Pinned at 0.0.33 by @lhci/cli@0.15.1 → inquirer@6.5.2 → external-editor@3.1.0 → tmp@0.0.33 (devDependency only — Lighthouse CI for the perf budget check in CI). The advisory is path traversal via unsanitized prefix/postfix arguments to tmp.dirSync/fileSync; @lhci/cli never passes user-controlled values to those calls, and the package is never loaded by the production server bundle. Re-review when @lhci/cli ships a release that upgrades inquirer (or replaces external-editor).

Reissued advisory for the same tmp path-traversal class as 1119610 (patched >=0.2.6). Both findings are @lhci/cli-only chains: tmp@0.0.33 via inquirer→external-editor and tmp@0.1.0 as a direct @lhci/cli dep — devDependency-only Lighthouse CI tooling; @lhci/cli never passes user-controlled prefix/postfix to tmp, and the package never reaches the production server bundle. testcontainers' tmp is already 0.2.6 (patched). Re-review when @lhci/cli upgrades its tmp/inquirer chain.

The advisory's vector is esbuild's DENO module downloading platform binaries without integrity verification when NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY points elsewhere (patched >=0.28.1). All three findings here are pnpm-installed npm devDependency chains (vite/vitest toolchain at 0.28.0, /cli at 0.28.0, drizzle-kit at 0.25.12 and 0.18.20 via -kit) where binaries ship as pinned optionalDependencies resolved through the lockfile, not the Deno download path; nothing reaches the production bundle. A pnpm override to 0.28.1 would force drizzle-kit's pinned 0.18/0.25 esbuild across majors. Re-review when vite/serwist/drizzle-kit ship releases on >=0.28.1.

Same @lhci/cli devDependency chains as 1119610/1120654 — tmp@0.0.33 via inquirer→external-editor and tmp@0.1.0 as a direct @lhci/cli dep (Lighthouse CI perf-budget tooling). This is the type-confusion variant of the tmp path-traversal class: a non-string prefix/postfix/template bypasses _assertPath (patched >=0.2.6). @lhci/cli never passes user-controlled prefix/postfix to tmp, and the package never reaches the production server bundle; testcontainers' own tmp is already 0.2.6 (patched). Re-review when @lhci/cli upgrades its tmp/inquirer chain.

vite@8.0.14 via @vitest/mocker → vitest (devDependency only — Cairn's test toolchain). The advisory is a server.fs.deny bypass on Windows via alternate path syntax (backslash / 8.3 short names) in vite's dev server. Cairn never runs the vite dev server (the app server is Next.js/Turbopack; vite is present only as Vitest's transform engine), CI and production both run Linux so the Windows-only path vector does not apply, and vite never ships in the standalone production bundle. Re-review when vitest's pinned vite dependency moves to a patched release.

Same chain as 1117571 — onnx-proto pins protobufjs@6.11.x via @xenova/transformers → onnxruntime-web. DoS through unbounded Any expansion during protobuf JSON conversion; requires attacker-controlled protobuf JSON input. The only protobuf inputs in this codebase are bundled ONNX model files (operator-controlled) — no untrusted protobuf JSON reaches the library. A pnpm override to v7 still silently fails because onnx-proto's compiled output targets the v6 API. Re-review when @xenova/transformers drops onnx-proto or an equivalent ships against protobufjs v7.
